utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good afternoon. Madam Registrar, if you could call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. This is the case number, IT-05-88-R77.1-T in the contempt case of Dragan Jokic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. For the record, the accused is present, and he is being duly assisted as per a decision of the -- the Registrar by Madam Branislava Isailovic, who is also present. Mr. Jokic, I just want a confirmation from you that you can follow the proceedings, that you are able to follow the proceedings in your own language.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I'm able to follow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. I thank you. So these are contempt proceedings, and they follow pursuant to our 1st November order in lieu of indictment on contempt concerning the present accused, Dragan Nikolic -- Dragan Jokic, born on the 20th of August, 1957, who is being charged that on two occasions during the proceedings in the trial the Prosecutor versus Vujadin Popovic et al.; and namely, on the 31st of October and on the 1st of November, 2007 being called to testify before that Trial Chamber, he knowingly and willfully interfered with the administration of -- of justice by contumaciously refusing to testify contrary to what is provided in Rule 77(A)(i) of the Rules. I'll read to you what is stated in Rule 77(A)(i) of the Rules, Mr. Jokic, and then I will ask you how you wish to plead to this charge of contempt of court. Rule 77 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of this Tribunal, in paragraph (A)(i) states that: "The Tribunal in the exercise of its inherent power may hold in contempt those who knowingly and wilfully interfere with its administration of justice, including any person who being a witness before a Chamber, contumaciously refuses or fails to answer a question." This is the charge that is being brought against you. How do you wish to plead to this charge? Guilty or not guilty, Mr. Jokic?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I plead not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. And we can therefore proceed from there. The first thing that we will do is to enter -- and Madam Registrar, you are being charged with -- with doing this -- enter into the records of the case the relative parts from the transcript of the sittings of the 31st October and 1st November 2007 in the records of this case. Ms. Isailovic.

utterances.speaker: MS. ISAILOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour and Judges. Thank you for giving me the floor. As counsel for Mr. Jokic, I would like to say that Mr. Jokic, who just pleaded not guilty, would like to ask for some time in order to prepare for his defence. According to the scheduling order, I did not obtain enough information yet. I only have the scheduling order, and I believed that it was just to enter a plea that the scheduling order was decided. And so today I'm ready to give you some elements regarding how Defence could prepare its case, regarding the time required, for example. And then I would like to obtain a ruling from you on this. And, of course, I will abide by your decision.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: What time frame did you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: MS. ISAILOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I -- if possible, I would at least like to obtain three weeks. As you know, I depend from OLAD and from the Tribunal's services for a number of steps that are required. In the meanwhile, waiting for this schedule -- this hearing, I've already started a few steps in order to make the time required as short as possible. To support my request for additional time, I would like to tell you that I believe I may bring one or two witnesses. I would like also to collect information according to Article 92 bis -- under Rule 92 bis, but I need some time for translation and certification, because this unfortunately might not save a great amount of time. But I've also planned to have a viva voce witness, as well as an expert witness. I need to collect a few documents. And, of course, I need some of these documents to be translated. Some of these documents are already in English, in an official language of this Tribunal, so given the experience I already have with these proceedings and the interpretation services, I believe that the minimum time required is three weeks. Possibly more. I hope that three weeks would be enough.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: What will be the date three weeks from now?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So the position is as follows, Ms. Isailovic: The next hearing will be in three weeks from today, and that will be the 10th of -- of December, at 3.00 in the afternoon. The courtroom will be announced -- will be identified later, whether it's Courtroom I, II, or III. I -- I can't tell you from now. But on that day, we are not going to have a Status Conference. We are going to have a hearing, in a sense that if you have witnesses, we will hear those witnesses on that -- on that day. If there are preliminary pleas of any sort, we will hear them on that day. So for that purpose, in order for us to be prepared and for everyone to be prepared, we would kindly -- kindly ask you that within a week from today - that's today week - end of business, which would be 4.00 or something like that, you will inform us formally by means of a filing of any witnesses that you would like to produce. You should be able to -- to do that within a week from today, because you have ample time to consult with your client between now and -- and then. All right? And also give us notification, specific notification of any plea that may -- may come to your mind. Although, I don't really see any at the -- for the time being. But in any case, we are giving you this opportunity, should it occur to your mind. So a week from today, this filing. And then three weeks from today, we will have a hearing, a sitting.

utterances.speaker: MS. ISAILOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, if I may ask for just a little arrangement over this postponement. In the meanwhile, waiting for this hearing I've planned for a few things I had to do, and on Monday, the 26th, I will be on assignment to collect these testimonies and to be absolutely sure that these witnesses will come, either one or two witnesses. Regarding the expert, I'm sure that she will be there. She's already been appointed. And she will start working as -- as of tomorrow on all this. But if you could please postpone by two days and maybe allow me for Wednesday, the 28th as a deadline. I don't have a case manager. I'm doing the work all by myself, and which is why I need some additional time in order to technically organise myself. So filing the submission -- I have to file the submission, write the submission, and file it after my assignment. So if I could please be allowed to file the submission on November 28 rather than November 26.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Okay. So we -- instead of the 26th, you will have up to the 28th to make the filing.

utterances.speaker: MS. ISAILOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. So I have a question. I've looked at the procedure. I did not obtain a great number of elements, because the case law of this Tribunal was a bit different from what we have here in court today. Maybe I need to do the same thing as in a regular procedure provided for in the 65 ter -- in Rule 65 ter (G), or do I need to do something different? Having a 65 ter list of witness and the summary of facts, some kind of a pre-trial brief with the Defence case? Do you need this kind of submission or not?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Let -- let me put it like this: We cannot dispense of -- with certain -- at least, a certain measure of formality, because that seems to be of the essence. However, this is not a big case. It's -- it's a case that can be disposed of within a relatively short time. What you would need to give us on the 28th is the list of witnesses that you intend to call; namely, name, a very brief summary of what you intend to prove by means of this witness, more or less what you have in paragraph (G), as you said, but, again, not everything that you find there applies or would apply to -- to -- to this witness. More or less we can guess what we are talking about. So in actual fact all we would need to know is whether both these witnesses would be able to testify in one day or whether you would require more than one day, in which case we would need to identify another day on which we -- we would sit. If there are any exhibits that you are already aware of, of course, you will indicate them. But that's about it. I don't think you need to go much beyond this elementary or rudimentary formality. Okay? All right. So I think we can ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I'm just being reminded that you might wish, although in such -- such a small case this may not be exactly the case, but you may -- you might wish to make an opening statement, if you so desire. I don't think it is really necessary, but if -- if you wish to do -- to make an opening statement, you're free to make one.

utterances.speaker: MS. ISAILOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, regarding this opening statement, I can tell you right away that there will probably -- there won't be an opening statement, but I do need some time for a closing argument. I would like to make a closing argument.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. So ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. So that brings today's sitting to an end. The registrar is to make arrangements for the next hearing to be held on the 10th of December at 3.00 in the afternoon. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday the 10th day of December, 2007, at 3.00 p.m. 17 18 19 20 21 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 2.41 p.m.,
